name: Have you included security considerations within a formal closeout report to be shared with relevant stakeholders?
conditionsText: The report should reflect the actual outcome of the retirement activity. This becomes particularly important if the project or delivery team itself is being closed, because any remaining responsibilities and risks need to be transferred rather than becoming ownerless. The guidance notes that senior responsible owners, service owners and product managers should be kept informed, and that the CISO or CDIO may need involvement where responsible project roles are being wound down
requirementTitle: Have you included security considerations within a formal closeout report to be shared with relevant stakeholders?
requirementDescription: Once the component or service has been retired, have you formally documented what was done, confirmed that the security actions were completed, recorded anything still outstanding, and shared that information with the appropriate people?
why:
A retirement project should not simply finish when a system is switched off.
There needs to be confidence that:
- components were actually decommissioned
- access was removed
- information was appropriately migrated or destroyed
- infrastructure was removed
- relevant records were updated
- outstanding security risks were identified
- someone remains responsible for those risks.
The closeout report creates an audit trail and provides senior stakeholders with assurance that decommissioning was completed safely
tasks: Have you included security considerations within a formal closeout report to be shared with relevant stakeholders?

actions.title: Have you included security considerations within a formal closeout report to be shared with relevant stakeholders?
actions.description:
Create a formal closeout report confirming:
• what was retired
• what security actions were completed
• how relevant data was handled
• whether access and infrastructure were removed
• whether asset records have been updated
• any outstanding actions
• any residual risks
• recommendations or follow-up activity
• who owns any remaining risks or responsibilities.
Share the report with the relevant stakeholders and decision-makers.
